dish.note: Squid rings in golden breadcrumbs, fried crisp, with lemon wedges and tartare.
dish.how: Cut 500g cleaned squid tubes into 1cm rings and pat dry. Dust in 75g seasoned plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g dried breadcrumbs. Heat vegetable oil 4cm deep to 180C and fry in batches for 2 minutes until golden. Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.
dish.make_ahead: Crumb the rings up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in the fridge on a tray

steps.text: Cut the squid tubes into 1cm rings and pat dry.
Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry the rings in batches until golden.
Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the fingers up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and pat dry.
Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden, about 2 minutes.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

dish.vegNote: Crumbed haloumi fingers fried crisp, with lemon wedges and tartare.
